result:
S1: filter ~(and (/state | eq "open") (/labels * lower | contains "bug")) | count
S2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~/assignee * count
S3: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(at :priority | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /id
S4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * (entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * /0) | flat | distinct | sort
S5: * {:customer /customer :total (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum)} | groupBy ~/customer * {:customer (first | /customer) :total (* /total | sum | round 2)} | vals | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
S6: /data/users | filter ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * (/email | lower) | sort
S7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split " " | filter ~(/1 | upper | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~/2 * count
S8: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
S9: filter ~(/published | eq true) * (at :tags | coalesce [] * lower | distinct | sort) | flat | groupBy ~(/) * count | entries * {:tag (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /tag]) | take 3
S10: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) * (at :port)
S11: filter ~(at :stock | coalesce 0 | gt 0) * (/category | lower) | distinct | sort
S12: "The cat and the Hat and THE bat sat on a mat with the cat" | split " " * lower | groupBy ~(/) * count | entries * {:word (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /word]) | take 3
S13: groupBy ~/user | vals * {:user (first | /user) :count count :first (* /ts | min)} | sort ~/user
S14: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * split "|" | filter ~(and (/1 | lower | startsWith "eu-") (/2 | ne "down")) | sort ~(/3 | parseJson | desc) * /0 | join ","
